item.title: Mochi Press 1.1
item.description:
• Mochi Press is now free.
  • New Finder Quick Actions: right-click any file → Quick Actions → Compress or Extract with Mochi Press.
  • Fixed: the Services menu items sometimes did nothing.
  • Automatic updates: Mochi Press now tells you when a new version is out.
  • Settings → About shows the version and more apps from Monokern.
